lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਤੀਣੇ ਤਾਰਾ ਚੜਿਆ ਲੰਮਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak haumai maar pateene taaraa chaRiaa la(n)maa ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, killing his ego, he is satisfied; the meteor has shot across the sky. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਗਿ ਰਹੇ ਚੂਕੀ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh jaag rahe chookee abhimaanee raam ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs remain awake and aware; their egotistical pride is eradicated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭੋਰੁ ਭਇਆ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadin bhor bhaiaa saach samaanee raam ||
lines.translation: Night and day, it is dawn for them; they merge in the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saach samaanee guramukh man bhaanee guramukh saabat jaage ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs are merged in the True Lord; they are pleasing to His Mind. The Gurmukhs are intact, safe and sound, awake and awake.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saach naam a(n)mrit gur deeaa har charanee liv laage ||
lines.translation: The Guru blesses them with the Ambrosial Nectar of the True Name; they are lovingly attuned to the Lord's Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pragatee jot jot mahi jaataa manamukh bharam bhulaanee ||
lines.translation: The Divine Light is revealed, and in that Light, they achieve realization; the self-willed manmukhs wander in doubt and confusion.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੋਰੁ ਭਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਜਾਗਤ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bhor bhaiaa man maaniaa jaagat rain vihaanee ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, when the dawn breaks, their minds are satisfied; they pass their life-night awake and aware. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਉਗਣ ਵੀਸਰਿਆ ਗੁਣੀ ਘਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: augan veesariaa gunee ghar keeaa raam ||
lines.translation: Forgetting faults and demerits, virtue and merit enter one's home.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਬੀਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: eko rav rahiaa avar na beeaa raam ||
lines.translation: The One Lord is permeating everywhere; there is no other at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸੋਈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: rav rahiaa soee avar na koee man hee te man maaniaa ||
lines.translation: He is All-pervading; there is no other. The mind comes to believe, from the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਲ ਥਲ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਘਟੁ ਘਟੁ ਥਾਪਿਆ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin jal thal tribhavan ghat ghat thaapiaa so prabh guramukh jaaniaa ||
lines.translation: The One who established the water, the land, the three worlds, each and every heart - that God is known by the Gurmukh.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧਿ ਮੇਟਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran samarath apaaraa tribidh met samaaee ||
lines.translation: The Infinite, All-powerful Lord is the Creator, the Cause of causes; erasing the three-phased Maya, we merge in Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਵਗਣ ਗੁਣਹ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਐਸੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak avagan gunah samaane aisee guramat paaee ||3||
lines.translation: O Nanak, then, demerits are dissolved by merits; such are the Guru's Teachings. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣ ਰਹੇ ਚੂਕਾ ਭੋਲਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavan jaan rahe chookaa bholaa raam ||
lines.translation: My coming and going in reincarnation have ended; doubt and hesitation are gone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਚੋਲਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai maar mile saachaa cholaa raam ||
lines.translation: Conquering my ego, I have met the True Lord, and now I wear the robe of Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਈ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਈ ਚੂਕੇ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai gur khoee paragat hoee chooke sog sa(n)taapai ||
lines.translation: The Guru has rid me of egotism; my sorrow and suffering are dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਤੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਆਪੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jotee a(n)dar jot samaanee aap pachhaataa aapai ||
lines.translation: My might merges into the Light; I realize and understand my own self.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਘਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਤੀਣੀ ਸਾਹੁਰੜੈ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: peeeaRai ghar sabad pateenee saahuraRai pir bhaanee ||
lines.translation: In this world of my parents' home, I am satisfied with the Shabad; at my in-laws' home, in the world beyond, I shall be pleasing to my Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਚੂਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ਲੋਕਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak satigur mel milaaee chookee kaan lokaanee ||4||3||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the True Guru has united me in His Union; my dependence on people has ended. ||4||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਖਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: tukhaaree mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Tukhaari, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੋਲਾਵੜੈ ਭੁਲੀ ਭੁਲਿ ਭੁਲਿ ਪਛੋਤਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bholaavaRai bhulee bhul bhul pachhotaanee ||
lines.translation: Deluded by doubt, misled and confused, the soul-bride later regrets and repents.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰਿ ਛੋਡਿਅੜੀ ਸੁਤੀ ਪਿਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pir chhodiaRee sutee pir kee saar na jaanee ||
lines.translation: Abandoning her Husband Lord, she sleeps, and does not appreciate His Worth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਸੁਤੀ ਅਵਗਣਿ ਮੁਤੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਨ ਵਿਧਣ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: pir chhodee sutee avagan mutee tis dhan vidhan raate ||
lines.translation: Leaving her Husband Lord, she sleeps, and is plundered by her faults and demerits. The night is so painful for this bride.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਵਿਗੁਤੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਲਗੀ ਤਾਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh aha(n)kaar vigutee haumai lagee taate ||
lines.translation: Sexual desire, anger and egotism destroy her. She burns in egotism.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਡਰਿ ਹੰਸੁ ਚਲਿਆ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ਭਸਮੈ ਭਸਮ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: udar ha(n)s chaliaa phuramaaiaa bhasamai bhasam samaanee ||
lines.translation: When the soul-swan flies away, by the Command of the Lord, her dust mingles with dust.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੀ ਭੁਲਿ ਭੁਲਿ ਪਛੋਤਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sache naam vihoonee bhul bhul pachhotaanee ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, without the True Name, she is confused and deluded, and so she regrets and repents. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਨਾਹ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਇਕ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun naah piaare ik bena(n)tee meree ||
lines.translation: Please listen, O my Beloved Husband Lord, to my one prayer.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਅੜਾ ਹਉ ਰੁਲਿ ਭਸਮੈ ਢੇਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: too nij ghar vasiaRaa hau rul bhasamai dheree ||
lines.translation: You dwell in the home of the self deep within, while I roll around like a dust-ball.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਅਪਨੇ ਨਾਹੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਚਾਹੈ ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin apane naahai koi na chaahai kiaa kaheeai kiaa keejai ||
lines.translation: Without my Husband Lord, no one likes me at all; what can I say or do now?

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸਨ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit naam rasan ras rasanaa gurasabadee ras peejai ||
lines.translation: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the sweetest nectar of nectars. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, with my tongue, I drink in this nectar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਸਾਥੀ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਘਨੇਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: vin naavai ko sa(n)g na saathee aavai jaai ghaneree ||
lines.translation: Without the Name, no one has any friend or companion; millions come and go in reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਾਹਾ ਲੈ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਚੁ ਮਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak laahaa lai ghar jaaeeai saachee sach mat teree ||2||
lines.translation: Nanak: the profit is earned and the soul returns home. True, true are Your Teachings. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਦੇਸਿ ਵਿਦੇਸੀਅੜੇ ਸਾਨੇਹੜੇ ਦੇਦੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: saajan des videseeaRe saanehaRe dedee ||
lines.translation: O Friend, You have travelled so far from Your homeland; I send my message of love to You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਤਿਨ ਸਜਣਾ ਮੁੰਧ ਨੈਣ ਭਰੇਦੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: saar samaale tin sajanaa mu(n)dh nain bharedee ||
lines.translation: I cherish and remember that Friend; the eyes of this soul-bride are filled with tears.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਧ ਨੈਣ ਭਰੇਦੀ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੇਦੀ ਕਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mu(n)dh nain bharedee gun saaredee kiu prabh milaa piaare ||
lines.translation: The eyes of the soul-bride are filled with tears; I dwell upon Your Glorious Virtues. How can I meet my Beloved Lord God?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪੰਥੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਉ ਵਿਖੜਾ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: maarag pa(n)th na jaanau vikhaRaa kiu paaeeai pir paare ||
lines.translation: I do not know the treacherous path, the way to You. How can I find You and cross over, O my Husband Lord?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਆਗੈ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigurasabadee milai vichhu(n)nee tan man aagai raakhai ||
lines.translation: Through the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru, the separated soul-bride meets with the Lord; I place my body and mind before You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸ ਫਲਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak a(n)mrit birakh mahaa ras phaliaa mil preetam ras chaakhai ||3||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the ambrosial tree bears the most delicious fruits; meeting with my Beloved, I taste the sweet essence. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਇੜੀਏ ਬਿਲਮੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahal bulaaiReee bilam na keejai ||
lines.translation: The Lord has called you to the Mansion of His Presence - do not delay!
